svg.title: Project 2: WordPress on AWS Lightsail
svg.desc: Visitors reach a Lightsail instance through its static IP over HTTPS. The instance runs the Bitnami WordPress stack (Apache, PHP, MySQL and WordPress) with a Let’s Encrypt certificate installed by the bncert tool. Lightsail takes automatic daily snapshots, and the administrator uses browser-based SSH.

text.tspan: A WordPress blog on one Lightsail instance, with a static IP, free HTTPS and automatic daily snapshots, for five dollars a month.
Amazon Lightsail, $5 plan: 512 MB memory, 2 vCPUs, 20 GB SSD
Readers reach the blog over HTTPS on the instance’s static IP.
Apache and PHP run WordPress, with the database on the same instance.
Lightsail snapshots the whole instance every day, so it can be restored.
Admin work, like running bncert or reading the app password, uses browser SSH.
